SooqLink

B2B wholesale marketplace platform currently in development, designed to connect sellers with buyers such as grocery stores, restaurants, hotels, cafés, stationery stores, and individual customers through a centralized digital marketplace. Blood Line

Comprehensive blood donation management platform built using a client-server architecture to connect donors, hospitals, and blood banks through mobile and desktop applications. Developed with Flutter, Flask, and RESTful APIs, the system streamlines appointment scheduling, donation tracking, blood drive management, and donor communication. Features include JWT authentication, role-based functionality, Google Maps integration for locating nearby donation centers, notifications for urgent blood needs, donation history tracking, and secure backend API testing with Postman.

Bookify

Flutter-based book rental application designed to help users browse, search, and rent books through a clean and modern mobile interface. The platform includes role-based functionality for Users and Admins, allowing admins to manage books, upload cover images, update availability status, and oversee rental orders. Features include book search, detailed book pages, rental history tracking, SQLite local storage, and state management using Riverpod for a responsive and scalable user experience.

Search Algorithm Visualizer

Interactive Python application built with Tkinter to visualize binary tree traversal algorithms through real-time animations and dynamic node highlighting. The project demonstrates how Breadth-First Search (BFS) and Depth-First Search (DFS) operate on a binary tree structure, allowing users to select target nodes and observe the traversal process step-by-step through an intuitive graphical interface.
